candidates.title: Send a triggered email through Make

demandEvidence.chore: Send an email through a provider when another app trigger occurs.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want a Make scenario to send an email through DigitalAka when a trigger occurs in another app.

ease.reason: A beginner can mock one trigger and email, but no supplied reference documents provider setup or delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent automation consultants may pay for setup help; the request proves no AI service buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can use a sample trigger and test inbox; live SMTP configuration and delivery remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A configured trigger might repeat the send, but a person must authorize credentials, verify delivery and handle failures.

evidence.reason: The fresh request names provider email after another app trigger, but gives no frequency, constraints or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 4.6). The bounded trigger-to-email test is imaginable, but the attached evidence and available references do not support implementation mechanics; no post proposed.

candidates.title: Prepare an image background removal

demandEvidence.chore: Remove an image background to produce a transparent PNG.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I used to use this tool, remove.bg, for getting transparent PNGs from either stock images or my own images.

ease.reason: A sample-image mock can test the single output, but no supplied reference supports image processing or quality checks.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: some independent creative professionals may pay for image preparation; one comment establishes neither a buyer nor recurring demand.

feasibility.reason: A four-week demo could process operator-supplied sample images, while quality across image types and production handling are unverified.

autonomy.reason: A tool could return a file per input, but a person must check edges and accept or correct poor results.

evidence.reason: The comment identifies prior use to make transparent PNGs, but provides no current request, volume, constraints or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 4.2). A one-image input/output test is scorable, but the source is a brief past-use statement with no recurring workflow or implementation evidence.

candidates.title: Route a Make scenario error for review

demandEvidence.chore: Debug and finish an existing Make build rather than rebuild it.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Since you’re posting under Hire a Pro → Hire Help , I’d make it clear that you want someone to debug and finish an existing Make build , not rebuild everything from scratch.

ease.reason: A mock can route a supplied error note; Make documents configured error interception (428eda549e557f199c3af452), not diagnosis.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent automation consultants may value failure triage; the request does not establish an AI service buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week demo can route synthetic errors to a review log; the reference supports interception only, not debugging or completing a build (428eda549e557f199c3af452).

autonomy.reason: Configured error handling can intercept a module failure (428eda549e557f199c3af452), while a person must diagnose and change the real scenario.

evidence.reason: The request asks for debugging and finishing, but names no failure or diagnostic output; the reference only explains error interception.

candidates.reason: Below threshold (mean 4.4). This fresh reread adds no fault details; the Make reference supports configured error interception only, leaving diagnosis and finishing to a person.

steps.message: Assessed every assigned discussion. Three bounded chores received five provisional scores and all are below the threshold; four assignments were excluded for insufficiently scoped or safe repeatable work. No post proposed.
